subject: Fermi Gamma-ray Burst Monitor trigger 800627191/260516518 is not a GRB
body:
U. Pathak (IITB) reports on behalf of the Fermi Gamma-ray Burst Monitor Team:

"The Fermi Gamma-ray Burst Monitor (GBM) trigger 800627191/260516518 at 12:26:26.60 UT
on 16 May 2026, tentatively classified as a GRB, is in fact not due
to a GRB. This trigger is likely due to local particles."
